proposals.title: After the first near-miss, lock the region and sweep one parameter monotonically
proposals.trigger: A rollout returns NOT_SOLVED but its frames show the goal object was displaced toward the target (moved, rolled, or nearly contacted) rather than untouched, and the budget is still mostly unspent.
procedure: Declare that placement the anchor: fix two of the three parameters (usually x and y) at its values.
Change only the remaining parameter, in a single consistent direction, in steps of roughly 10-15% of its range, on consecutive attempts.
Keep stepping in that direction while each rollout's frames show the goal object getting closer to the target than the previous one.
Reverse direction once and halve the step the first time progress worsens; then continue the ladder from the better side.
Only after the ladder has been run to both the improving and worsening ends do you release the anchor and pick a new region.
Never interleave an unrelated far-away probe into an active ladder; finish the ladder first.
successSignals: Consecutive attempts differ in exactly one parameter
Each rollout's goal-object end position is monotonically nearer the target along the ladder
Solve occurs within a short run of same-line attempts
failureSignals: Consecutive actions change x, y and radius at once
Attempts hop between distant regions while no region has been swept
Same coarse region revisited many attempts apart with no ordering
recovery: If the full ladder ends with no improvement at either extreme, mark that anchor's whole band refuted and move the anchor a full ball-diameter to a region not yet swept, then start a fresh ladder immediately.
invariants: Uses only frames already returned by prior attempts; requests no extra rollout
One parameter changes per attempt while a ladder is active

proposals.title: Treat every tried placement and every overlap as a permanently excluded cell
proposals.trigger: About to emit a placement whose (x, y) is within roughly one ball radius of a placement already tried this episode, or within a region where an earlier placement returned INVALID_INPUT.
procedure: Maintain a running list of tried (x, y, radius) with their outcome and of every INVALID_INPUT coordinate.
If the candidate's centre is within one radius of a previously NOT_SOLVED placement of similar radius, discard it unless it is the next rung of an active ladder.

If the candidate's centre lies in or adjacent to a prior INVALID_INPUT coordinate, either shrink the radius below the overlap margin or shift the centre at least one radius away from the occupied spot before emitting.
Prefer the nearest untried cell of the coarse grid over any re-probe of an explored cell.
When several untried cells remain, choose the one whose line of fall toward the goal object is least obstructed in the initial frame.
successSignals: Zero exact or near-duplicate repeats of previously tried actions
INVALID_INPUT rate stays near zero after the first few attempts
Coverage of the plausible region grows with each attempt
failureSignals: The same coordinate reappears with trivially different radius late in the episode
Repeated overlap errors at coordinates already known to be occupied
recovery: If the duplicate filter leaves no candidate, widen the grid to the whole scene rather than re-probing an explored cell, and record the expansion.
invariants: No extra observations or probes are spent; the exclusion list comes from results already received
